newsitem.title: USA: Clifton Mining mine value raised.
newsitem.headline: Clifton Mining mine value raised.

text.p: Clifton Mining Co said Thursday the value of its mineral resources in its Hidden Mine shear vein on the Utah/Nevada border has been upgraded by 31 percent following a recently completed assay program.

The company said that in a surface and underground sampling program reviewed and approved by international mining consultant Behre Dolbear & Co Inc, the project's proven and probable resources increased by about 105,000 tons upon the almost 339,000 tons confirmed in previous reports.

The company said the sampled vein assayed at an estimated 889,409 ounces of silver, 2,562 ounces of gold and 12,033,802 pounds of lead, increasing the project's estimated silver, gold and lead totals to 3,688,465 ounces, 16,067 ounces and 48,742,967 pounds, respectively.

Calculated using prices of silver at US$4.75 per ounce, gold at US$345 per ounce and lead at US$0.48 per pound, the company said its gross resource value improved to US$46.5 million, up 31 percent from US$35.6 million.

The company said drilling and sampling will continue on existing veins, with additional anticipated resource increases announced as they are approved by an independent mine engineering company. The company said the project should be completed in "the coming months."
